description.value: Pizza Pizza is a Canadian pizza chain founded in 1967 with over 750 locations coast to coast, including this Delta outpost. Cyclists can grab a quick hot meal with a wide range of pizza styles, sides, and specialty items. The location is open late into the night, making it a convenient stop on longer evening rides.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Pizza Pizza location in Delta with phone +1 (604) 277-1111 matching OSM. However, the street number differs: OSM records 8360 while the website lists 8380 112 Street Unit 120 — the website value is used as more authoritative. Takeout is confirmed via OSM takeaway=yes and the website's 'Order Now' functionality; gluten-free crust and plant-based items are explicitly described on the website, confirming GF and vegan options. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike rack, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: Street number mismatch: OSM records 8360 112 Street but the Pizza Pizza website lists 8380 112 Street Unit 120. Website value (8380) used as authoritative; OSM should be corrected.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open fast food location useful to touring cyclists for hot food, late hours, and GF/plant-based options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website confirms gluten-free crust ('prepared, cooked and cut with dedicated utensils') and plant-based items (Plant-Based Chick'n Bites listed in nutrition section)
